reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name
FROM products
WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_lines WHERE promo_id IS NOT NULL)
alternatives:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM order_lines ol
  WHERE ol.product_id = p.product_id
    AND ol.promo_id IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE ol.promo_id IS NOT NULL

other_way.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE ol.promo_id IS NOT NULL
other_way.tradeoff: A join with DISTINCT gives the same products, but the join first repeats each product once per line.
